parties: Banwarilal Malu; Malu Paper Mills Limited
headline: Banwarilal Malu files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Banwarilal Malu has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE confirming a substantial acquisition of shares in Malu Paper Mills Limited. The filing triggers mandatory disclosure obligations under the SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011, signalling a material change in shareholding.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures signal entry into the 5–10% trigger band and require open-market/off-market acquisition disclosures; subsequent filings will clarify deal structure (preferential/open offer mechanics) and timeline to open offer if threshold is breached.
detail: Banwarilal Malu has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, to the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE). This disclosure is mandatory when a person acquires 5% or more (up to 10%) of the voting rights in a listed company through substantial acquisition. The filing confirms a material shareholding change in Malu Paper Mills Limited and triggers ongoing transparency obligations under the Takeover Code. No offer price, target percentage stake, or deal value is disclosed in the primary NSE filing.
